parsed.name: 通用通信端口
parsed.description: 用于实验仪器与计算机之间进行字节流或文本命令通信的通用通信端口，可完成连接管理、数据收发、缓冲区刷新以及基于模式的应答读取，常用于控制和读取带串行或类似命令接口的实验设备。
parsed.description_en: A general communication port used for byte-stream or text-command communication between a computer and laboratory instruments. It supports connection management, data transfer, buffer flushing, and pattern-based reply reading, and is commonly used to control and read instruments with serial or similar command interfaces.
